summary: Full backend + frontend regression on Toko Bagus (POS/Kasir) app. 13/13 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend loads on mobile viewport, seed data intact (2267 products, 86 transactions), Rp formatting correct ('Rp 6.000'), cart flow works, Riwayat shows omzet Rp 2.480.361, Pengaturan loads settings 'TOKO BAGUS' and correctly shows 'hanya tersedia di aplikasi hasil build' info toast on printer scan (non-native environment). Backup export/import round-trip verified. No deprecated Expo packages found. No React Native red screen. No critical issues.

minor.issue: Destructive endpoint has no snapshot/rollback safety and no schema validation on the incoming payload beyond `products` key presence. A malformed payload with valid `products` key but garbage entries would wipe & repopulate DB. Consider validating each product/transaction shape before mass insert.

Stock decrement is not atomic with the transaction insert (no session/transaction) — partial state possible if a mid-loop crash occurs. Also, no validation prevents overselling (stock can go negative).
Missing — cannot delete test/erroneous transactions; a spurious tx from testing now persists in seed history.

issues: All seeded products show 'Stok: 9999' — likely by design (seed value) but user-facing stock number is misleading.

react_native_issues.issue: pengaturan.tsx imports 'expo-file-system/legacy' (line 6). This is the legacy SDK54 subpath — main agent should migrate to the new expo-file-system API before it is removed in a future SDK. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/pengaturan.tsx:6
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from a third-party lib (@gorhom/bottom-sheet or similar). Non-blocking, but worth checking for a version bump.

action_items: Consider adding a DELETE /api/transactions/{id} endpoint for correction/cleanup use-cases.
Add validation/atomicity for POST /api/backup/import (currently wipes DB on any request with a `products` key).
Migrate 'expo-file-system/legacy' import in pengaturan.tsx to the modern expo-file-system API.
Optional: prevent negative stock on POST /api/transactions or at least flag it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 397 lines — well under 700 line threshold, single-file OK for MVP.
MongoDB _id is properly stripped via clean() helper on all read paths.
All endpoints use async/await; no sync blocking IO.
Backend correctly reads MONGO_URL and DB_NAME from env; no hardcoded URLs.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via /app/frontend/src/api.ts (verified indirectly — all API calls reach backend successfully).
All interactive elements audited have testID attributes (kasir-*, produk-*, checkout-*, form-*, set-*, printer-*, backup-*, riwayat-*).
Currency helper renders IDR format 'Rp 6.000' correctly (dot thousand separator, no decimals).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test suite creates and cleans up TEST_ prefixed products. One transaction (Rp 3.000) from create-transaction test persists in history (transactions count went 85 -> 86) because no DELETE /api/transactions endpoint exists — data is otherwise intact (2267 products preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_api.py. Backup export/import test (test_zzz_...) is destructive but self-restoring (re-imports the same export). If seeded count drifts below 2000, re-run the app's seed by wiping DB and restarting backend (seed_if_empty triggers when db.products is empty).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs to root-cause. Extra test transaction (Rp 3.000 on 11 Agu 2026) is expected side-effect of transaction creation test given no delete endpoint.
